description: The late-game Classic tower (late-game-classic, derived by scripts/derive-late-game-fixture.ts: the card-text winning tower with sky lobbies, a full elevator pool, a parking ramp and 3,000 leased offices, so 18,000 office workers, plus its medical center, two security offices, two suites, nine recycling centers and favorable VIP visit, at star 4 with its metro station rebuilt and still under construction) climbs to five stars once the station opens, then sells the station before crowning floor 100 with a wedding hall. On day 3 the VIP inspects a tower with no operational metro and leaves unimpressed, which books the next visit five days later; the metro is rebuilt, a reload carries the booked visit, and on day 8 the second inspection makes the tower a TOWER.
